disclosures: This study is a historical longitudinal complement, not a new independent confirmation or a reopening of frequency selection.
The continuous path begins after the documented January 2018 Kraken gap; no candles are interpolated, forward-filled or substituted from another venue.
All seven frozen passive schedule phases are executed and every two-month and quarterly phase is aggregated with equal weight; no best phase is selected.
A single long historical path measures cumulative consistency but cannot establish robustness by itself.
MonthlyDCA remains the official passive benchmark unless a separately preregistered future study changes that decision.
